decisions.reason: Indoor air quality monitoring remains relevant and the module complements the platform, so the option is kept while its market is still developing.
As a core analog input module replacing a previous version, it is central to the platform and unlikely to be dropped.
CAN bus is a standard industrial interface with stable demand, making the option valuable to keep.
CO2 measurement is increasingly important for ventilation and indoor air quality, so the module is kept as a low-cost option.
